pages.lesson:
LESSON: MANAGEMENT AND CONSERVATION OF THE ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments
Topic 4.4: Management and Conservation of the Environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Management and Conservation of the Environment. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Management and Conservation of the Environment
2. Practise Management and Conservation of the Environment at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management and Conservation of the Environment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Management and Conservation of the Environment
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Management and Conservation of the Environment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Management and Conservation of the Environment at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Management and Conservation of the Environment at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management and Conservation of the Environment
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Management and Conservation of the Environment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Management and Conservation of the Environment using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Management and Conservation of the Environment in the examples.
2. Explain Management and Conservation of the Environment to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Management and Conservation of the Environment.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Management and Conservation of the Environment using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Management and Conservation of the Environment important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Management and Conservation of the Environment
2. Practise Management and Conservation of the Environment at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Management and Conservation of the Environment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
